buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Generic 1. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 2. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. 4. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 5. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 6. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 7. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Payment online through RTGS / internet banking in Beneficiary name NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF WIND ENERGY Account No. 2874101015439 IFSC Code CNRB0002874 Bank Name CANARA BANK Branch address NIOT BRANCH PALLIKARANAI CHENNAI 600100 . Bidder to indicate bid number and name of bidding entity in the transaction details field at the time of on- line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer along with bid. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses JOINT VENTURE/CONSORTIUM a) “BIDDER” shall mean Bidding Company or a Bidding Consortium submitting the Bid. Any reference to th e Bidder includes Bidding Company/ Bidding Consortium, Member of a Bidding Consortium including its suc cessors, executors and permitted assigns and Lead Member of the Bidding Consortium jointly and severally, as the context may require; b) The Lead bidder shall be specified in the consortium agreement. c) The Lead bidder shall be responsible for the overall execution of the contract. d) The EMD / Security Dep osit have to be paid by the Lead Member of Bidding Consortium. e) Bidding Consortiums will not be eligible for any benefits (EMD / Turnover/ Prior experience, etc.) under public procurement policy for MSE’s . f) In case of a Bidding Consortium, a Power of Attorney in favour of the Lead Member issued by the other Members of the Consortium shall be provided in original as per format attached at Annexure -K along with Consortium Agreement as per format attached at Annexure – L in the Techno – commercial bid. g) Joint Ve nture (JV) / Consortium agreement duly registered with the competent authority needs to be submitted alo ng with Technical Bid. h) The lead bidder should have more than 50% shareholding. i) Lead bidder shall m eet the prescribed technical criteria in one of the areas on their own and submit completion certificate to e valuate fulfilment of PQ. Combined strength of consortium or JV shall be considered for evaluation. j) The maximum number of members in a JV/Consortium shall be 3. The format of Consortium agreement and Po wer of Attorney are attached as Annexure-K & Annexure – L of the ATC document. .
